description: The gold_* and should_trigger columns were written in one pass by an AI coding agent (2026-10-10), not by a person. They are independent of the repository's models (agreement with the pipeline: event 67%, sentiment 60%) but are NOT human ground truth.
how_to_replace: Label the same rows by hand with `uv run python scripts/eval/label_cli.py --annotator "<name>"`, set label_source to 'human' here, and measure agreement on a second pass with `--agreement <relabel.csv>`.
